dct_title_s: Holy See (Vatican City State) : Sea Ports (OpenStreetMap Export)
dct_description_sm: Sea ports and ferry terminals from OSM, tagged via `amenity`, `building`, or `port`. Useful for maritime logistics, supply-chain analysis, and coastal access planning. OpenStreetMap is a free, collaborative world map built by volunteers. Completeness varies by region: urban areas are usually well-mapped, remote areas may be incomplete. Cross-check critical decisions with local field knowledge. - Source: [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org) - OSM tags: [Key:amenity](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:amenity), [Key:building](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:building), [Key:port](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:port) - Part of many [exports grid on HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hot) by the [HOT](https://www.hotosm.org/en/)
